rpg.name: RPG (Role-Playing Game)
rpg.description: Games where players assume the roles of characters in a fictional setting. Features character progression, story-driven gameplay, and often includes quests and exploration.

action.name: Action
action.description: Fast-paced games emphasizing physical challenges, hand-eye coordination, and reaction time. Often features combat and movement mechanics.

horror.name: Horror
horror.description: Games designed to frighten and unsettle players through atmosphere, jump scares, and psychological tension.

strategy.name: Strategy
strategy.description: Games requiring careful planning and tactical thinking to achieve victory. Emphasizes decision-making over reflexes.

indie.name: Indie
indie.description: Games developed by independent studios or individuals. Often features innovative gameplay, unique art styles, and creative storytelling.

open_world.name: Open World
open_world.description: Games featuring large, explorable environments with freedom to approach objectives in various ways.

roguelike.name: Roguelike
roguelike.description: Games featuring procedurally generated levels, permanent death, and run-based progression.

simulation.name: Simulation
simulation.description: Games that simulate real-world activities or systems, from farming to city building.
